text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to copy human intelligence. Instead of just following fixed instructions, AI systems can learn from data and make decisions. Machine learning is a key part of this: computers study examples and improve over time without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning goes further by using artificial neural networks with many layers, which allows machines to recognise images, speech, and patterns. We use AI every day without noticing it. For example, it suggests films on streaming services, helps maps find the fastest route, filters spam emails, and powers voice assistants on our phones. AI is becoming a normal part of modern life.
